clock_alignment.title: Clock alignment in the archived move data
clock_alignment.description: Agreement with PGN clocks. Corrected index: 926,332/926,332 (100%); Archived index: 52,856/926,332 (5.71%). Archived opponent clock. Mover after move: 913,510/913,510 (100%); Opponent before move: 15,478/913,510 (1.69%). The exact-match outcomes in the second panel can overlap.

feature_gains.title: Incremental predictive value of clock information
feature_gains.description: Final-week histogram gradient boosting with the zero-risk rule. Add both clocks: 0.000893 [0.000510, 0.001284]. Then add recent time use: 0.000125 [0.000006, 0.000246]. Both additions vs baseline: 0.001018 [0.000658, 0.001429]. Intervals are paired 95% percentiles from 1,000 whole-game resamples.

model_comparison.title: Predictive performance on the verified cohort
model_comparison.description: Development · three-window mean. Training prevalence 0.290600, Logistic regression 0.265527, XGBoost 0.240731, Histogram boosting 0.239866. Final week · 24–30 September. Training prevalence 0.287146, Logistic regression 0.262458, XGBoost 0.235851, Histogram boosting 0.235150. All three fitted models use full inputs and the zero-risk rule. The prevalence baseline predicts the training event rate. The final week was previously evaluated.

phase_error_rates.title: Observed final-week serious-error rates by game phase
phase_error_rates.description: Opening: 1,468 serious errors in 49,954 moves (2.94%). Middlegame: 13,196 serious errors in 119,060 moves (11.08%). Endgame: 1,737 serious errors in 27,494 moves (6.32%). Overall: 16,401 serious errors in 196,508 moves (8.35%), 24–30 September.
